Constraints.entails D E -> Constraints.entails C E

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_greatest.type:

Constraints.entails (Constraints.meet C D) C /\
Constraints.entails (Constraints.meet C D) D /\
(Constraints.entails E C ->
 Constraints.entails E D ->
 Constraints.entails E (Constraints.meet C D))

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_nodup.type:

List.NoDup C -> List.NoDup (Constraints.meet C D)

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_sat.type:

Constraints.sat t C /\ Constraints.sat t D

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_singleton.type:

forall u : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat u C -> Constraints.sat u D -> u = t

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.memb_iff.type:

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.sat_decidable.type:

Clef.RFC0001.Representation.tagged_union.type:
exists decode : Types.tycon * Runtime.bits -> Types.tycon,
  forall (c : Types.tycon) (x : Runtime.atom c),
  decode (c, Runtime.repr c x) = c

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.call_through_entai.type:
forall (C D : Constraints.cset) (G : list Types.oty) 
  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
Constraints.entails C D ->
TypeCase.check D G e r = true ->
forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C -> TypeCase.well_typed_at t G e r

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.case_free_parametr.type:

TypeCase.seval t env e = TypeCase.seval u env e

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.case_free_uniform.type:

TypeCase.case_free e = true ->
exists m : TypeCase.mtm,

  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),

  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),

forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C ->
forall env : list Runtime.val,
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env (ListDef.map (Types.inst t) G) ->
exists v : Runtime.val,

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.both_match_in_meet.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset)
  (s : Regions.inst3),
Regions.valid CA CB s ->
Regions.matches r CA CB s Regions.IsA = true ->
Regions.matches r CA CB s Regions.IsB = true ->
Constraints.sat (Regions.iT s) (Constraints.meet CA CB)

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.coverage.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset)
  (arms : list Regions.test) (s : Regions.inst3),
List.In Regions.IsA arms ->
List.In Regions.IsB arms ->
Regions.valid CA CB s -> Regions.select r CA CB arms s <> None

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.diagonal_matches.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset) (x : Types.ty),
Constraints.sat x CA ->
Constraints.sat x CB ->
Regions.matches r CA CB
  {| Regions.iA := x; Regions.iB := x; Regions.iT := x |} Regions.IsA =
true /\
Regions.matches r CA CB
  {| Regions.iA := x; Regions.iB := x; Regions.iT := x |} Regions.IsB =
true

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.diagonal_valid.type:
forall (CA CB : Constraints.cset) (x : Types.ty),
Constraints.sat x CA ->
Constraints.sat x CB ->
Regions.valid CA CB
  {| Regions.iA := x; Regions.iB := x; Regions.iT := x |}

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.equation_refines.type:
forall (CA CB : Constraints.cset) (s : Regions.inst3)
  (p : Regions.test),
Regions.matches Regions.Equation CA CB s p = true ->
forall u : Types.ty,
List.In u (Regions.binder_types s p) -> u = Regions.iT s

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.find_app.type:
forall (A : Type) (f : A -> bool) (l1 l2 : list A),
List.find f (l1 ++ l2) =
match List.find f l1 with
| Some x => Some x
| None => List.find f l2
end

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.first_match_is_most.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset)
  (arms : list Regions.test) (s : Regions.inst3) 
  (p q : Regions.test),
Regions.ordered r CA CB nil arms = true ->
Regions.valid CA CB s ->
Regions.select r CA CB arms s = Some p ->
List.In q arms ->
Regions.matches r CA CB s q = true -> Regions.le r CA CB p q = true

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.intersection_first_.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset),
Regions.ordered r CA CB nil
  (Regions.Both Regions.IsA Regions.IsB
   :: Regions.IsA :: Regions.IsB :: nil) =
true

forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset)
  (s : Regions.inst3),
Regions.select r CA CB
  (Regions.Both Regions.IsA Regions.IsB
   :: Regions.IsA :: Regions.IsB :: nil)
  s =
Regions.select r CA CB
  (Regions.Both Regions.IsA Regions.IsB
   :: Regions.IsB :: Regions.IsA :: nil)
  s

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.intersection_reacha.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset),
(exists s : Regions.inst3,
   Regions.valid CA CB s /\
   Regions.matches r CA CB s (Regions.Both Regions.IsA Regions.IsB) =
   true) <->
Constraints.meet CA CB <> nil

Regions.le r CA CB p q = true <->
(forall s : Regions.inst3,

 Regions.matches r CA CB s p = true ->

forall p : Regions.test,
Regions.matches Regions.Membership CA CB s p =

x <> y ->
~
(forall (CA CB : Constraints.cset) (s : Regions.inst3)
   (p : Regions.test),
 Regions.valid CA CB s ->
 Regions.matches Regions.Membership CA CB s p = true ->

 List.In u (Regions.binder_types s p) -> u = Regions.iT s)

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.order_is_irrelevant.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset)
  (l1 l2 : list Regions.test) (s : Regions.inst3)
  (p1 p2 : Regions.test),
Regions.ordered r CA CB nil l1 = true ->
Regions.ordered r CA CB nil l2 = true ->
(forall p : Regions.test, List.In p l1 <-> List.In p l2) ->
Regions.valid CA CB s ->
Regions.select r CA CB l1 s = Some p1 ->
Regions.select r CA CB l2 s = Some p2 ->
Regions.le r CA CB p1 p2 = true /\ Regions.le r CA CB p2 p1 = true

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.ordered_most_specif.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset)
  (arms seen : list Regions.test) (s : Regions.inst3)
  (p q : Regions.test),
Regions.ordered r CA CB seen arms = true ->
Regions.valid CA CB s ->
List.find (Regions.matches r CA CB s) (seen ++ arms) = Some p ->
List.In q arms ->
Regions.matches r CA CB s q = true -> Regions.le r CA CB p q = true

forall (CA CB : Constraints.cset) (s : Regions.inst3)
  (arms : list Regions.test),

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.regions_partition.type:
forall (CA CB : Constraints.cset) (s : Regions.inst3),
Regions.valid CA CB s ->
let arms :=
  (Regions.Both Regions.IsA Regions.IsB
   :: Regions.IsA :: Regions.IsB :: nil)%list
  in
(Regions.select Regions.Equation CA CB arms s =
 Some (Regions.Both Regions.IsA Regions.IsB) <->
 Regions.iT s = Regions.iA s /\ Regions.iA s = Regions.iB s) /\
(Regions.select Regions.Equation CA CB arms s = Some Regions.IsA <->
 Regions.iT s = Regions.iA s /\ Regions.iA s <> Regions.iB s) /\
(Regions.select Regions.Equation CA CB arms s = Some Regions.IsB <->
 Regions.iT s = Regions.iB s /\ Regions.iA s <> Regions.iB s)

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.two_arms_order_matt.type:
forall (r : Regions.reading) (CA CB : Constraints.cset),
(forall s : Regions.inst3,
 Regions.valid CA CB s ->
 Regions.select r CA CB (Regions.IsA :: Regions.IsB :: nil) s =
 Regions.select r CA CB (Regions.IsB :: Regions.IsA :: nil) s) <->
Constraints.meet CA CB = nil

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.tyeqb_false.type: forall x y : Types.ty, x <> y -> Regions.tyeqb x y = false

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.tyeqb_iff.type: forall x y : Types.ty, Regions.tyeqb x y = true <-> x = y

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.tyeqb_neq.type: forall x y : Types.ty, Regions.tyeqb x y = false -> x <> y

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.tyeqb_refl.type: forall x : Types.ty, Regions.tyeqb x x = true

Clef.RFC0002.Regions.unordered_overlap_r.type:
forall x y : Types.ty,
x <> y ->
Regions.ordered Regions.Equation (x :: y :: nil)%list 
  (y :: nil)%list nil (Regions.IsA :: Regions.IsB :: nil) =
false

Clef.Spec.Witnesses.witness_sound.type:
forall (o : Witnesses.op) (a r : Types.ty) (v : Runtime.val),
Witnesses.witness o a = Some r ->
Runtime.has_ty v a ->
exists w : Runtime.val,
  Witnesses.apply o v = Some w /\ Runtime.has_ty w r
